answer: Require an aggregate credential score: each identity must hold at least 20 points of stamps from independent verifiers — a government ID check, a SIM-bound phone, a bank account, a social account older than two years — all bound to one key and re-checked every epoch, so a revoked stamp dies at once. A comet of fake identities needs a fresh kernel of real-world credentials per clone: forging a thousand costs a thousand ID checks, SIMs and aged accounts, while a sonnet of honest users passes once. Limits: it excludes the undocumented, and corrupt issuers can sell stamps.
